description: Apply a user-confirmed repository ingestion scope and start CueMap's incremental filesystem watcher. Always call cuemap_init_preview first for a new repository and obtain explicit user confirmation before setting confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms the previewed ingestion scope.

ignoredExtensions.description: Additional excluded extensions without a leading dot.

ignoredPatterns.description: Additional gitignore-style exclusion patterns approved by the user.

includedPaths.description: User-approved repository-relative files or folders. Empty means every supported file allowed by ignore rules.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

projectName.description: Optional project ID. Defaults to the stable repository-scoped CueMap project ID.

name: cuemap_init
